content.short: JumpTask is a micro-tasking Web3 platform that provides income-generating opportunities to everyone.
content.description: JumpTask is a micro-tasking Web3 platform that creates income-generating opportunities for people across the globe. You can earn by playing games, solving tasks, or sharing results, all within a single app. By design, JumpTask connects businesses with individuals through smart contracts, enabling transparent, verifiable work and timely rewards. The platform aims to broaden access to Web3 income streams by making participation simple, inclusive, and scalable for diverse users while leveraging decentralized technology to power everyday tasks.
